verdict.rationale: mParticle's own site claims it can score likelihood to churn, convert, or grow in value (roughly churn, purchase propensity and LTV) and then activate audiences on those scores, so the predictive half of the story is covered directly. That claim is only a marketing one-liner, and nothing in the pack documents computed traits or calculated attributes on profiles. Missing for 10: evidence of computed traits/calculated attributes on profiles, in-depth docs on how predictive scores are computed and stored on profiles, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, computed traits and predictive scores (LTV, churn or purchase propensity) are calculated on profiles and usable in targeting

citations.quote: Score likelihood to churn, convert, or grow in value, then activate audiences before risk or opportunity passes.
